admission.justification: Two commits can share a tree but have unrelated ancestry, so exact pair judgment requires the judged commit as well as its content.

applicability: A read of the recorded leaf memory base for a live or exact pair comparison.
conditions: Git can read the recorded base commit and tree.
The recorded base is an ancestor of the judged memory commit, or of the real memory worktree HEAD when no commit is supplied. A commit is its own ancestor for this comparison.
exclusions: A captured directory or a tree identifier does not witness commit ancestry.
Each caller maps failure to its own existing response.

evidence: BUG-R21-W2 code freeze and evidence archive, including exact successor and W1 failure witnesses
BUG-R21@v1 W2, exact source and independent W2 CODE PASS

statement: A recorded memory base must be readable and an ancestor of the judged memory commit or live memory HEAD for a leaf comparison to use it.
